stories.headline: Ukraine Strikes Kirishi Refinery, Knocking Out 40% of Russia's Oil Export Capacity

key_facts.fact: Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces struck the Kirishi oil refinery in Russia's Leningrad Oblast overnight March 25-26, igniting primary crude processing units and two storage tanks.
key_facts.excerpt: Units from Ukraine's defence forces struck the Kirishi oil refinery in Russia's Leningrad Oblast on the night of 25-26 March. Early information indicates a fire broke out on the facility's premises – igniting primary oil processing units and two storage tanks.

key_facts.fact: The Kirishi refinery ranks among Russia's three largest, with installed processing capacity of approximately 20-21 million tonnes of oil per year, accounting for over 6% of total Russian refining output.
key_facts.excerpt: The Kirishi refinery ranks among the three largest oil refineries in Russia. The plant has an installed processing capacity of approximately 20-21 million tonnes of oil per year and accounts for over 6% of the total oil refining output of the state.

key_facts.fact: At least 40% of Russia's oil export capacity — roughly 2 million barrels per day — is now halted due to Ukrainian drone attacks, tanker seizures, and Druzhba pipeline damage, the most severe disruption in Russia's modern history.
key_facts.excerpt: At least 40% of Russia's oil export capacity is at a halt as a result of Ukrainian drone attacks, the seizure of tankers and damage to the Druzhba pipeline. The disruption amounts to roughly two million barrels per day.

key_facts.fact: Affected infrastructure includes the Baltic ports of Primorsk and Ust-Luga, the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk operating below its 700,000 bpd capacity, and the Druzhba pipeline to Hungary and Slovakia.
key_facts.excerpt: It includes the ports of Primorsk and Ust-Luga as well as the Druzhba pipeline, which runs through Ukraine to Hungary and Slovakia.

key_facts.fact: Reuters described the shutdown as 'the most severe oil supply disruption in the modern history of Russia, the world's second largest oil exporter.'
key_facts.excerpt: The shutdown is the most severe oil supply disruption in the modern history of Russia, the world's second largest oil exporter, and has hit Moscow just as oil prices exceeded $100 a barrel due to the Iran war.

stories.headline: Yemen's Houthis Declare Readiness to Join Iran War, Threatening Bab al-Mandab Shipping

key_facts.excerpt: We stand fully militarily ready with all options. As for other details having to do with determining zero hour they are left to leadership and we are monitoring and following up with the developments and will know when is the suitable time to move.

key_facts.fact: The obvious Houthi target would be the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a key chokepoint controlling sea traffic toward the Suez Canal, after Iran effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: If the Houthis open a new front in the conflict, one obvious target would be the Bab al-Mandab Strait off the coast of Yemen, a key shipping chokepoint and narrow passageway that controls sea traffic towards the Suez Canal after Iran effectively shut the critical Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Shi'ite allies in Lebanon and Iraq have already joined the war, but the Houthis — capable of striking Gulf neighbours — have not yet entered the fray.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Shi'ite allies in Lebanon and Iraq have joined the war in the region unleashed by U.S. and Israeli strikes on Tehran. key_facts.fact: The sanctioned oil tanker Altura was struck by a maritime drone 14 miles from the Bosporus while carrying approximately 140,000 tonnes (about 1 million barrels) of crude oil from Novorossiysk.
key_facts.excerpt: The crude oil tanker Altura, under four separate sanctions, was attacked by a maritime drone 14 miles from the Bosporus. An explosion occurred on the tanker's bridge. The engine room flooded. The vessel was carrying 140,000 tons of crude oil.

key_facts.fact: The explosion hit the tanker's bridge and flooded the engine room, but all 27 Turkish crew members were unharmed.
key_facts.excerpt: According to Bloomberg, there are no fatalities or injuries among the crew, which includes 27 Turkish sailors.

key_facts.fact: The Altura is under EU, Swiss, Ukrainian, and UK sanctions. Its owner, Pergamon Denizcilik (Istanbul), is connected to Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani, whose father was a former Iranian security official.
key_facts.excerpt: The oil tanker Altura, subject to EU, Swiss, Ukrainian, and UK sanctions, was attacked by a drone in the Black Sea, 14 miles from the Bosporus.

key_facts.excerpt: A Turkish-operated oil tanker that had departed from Russia was struck by a naval drone on Thursday as it approached the Black Sea entrance to the Bosporus Strait, Turkish officials said. stories.headline: EU Parliament Advances US-EU Turnberry Trade Deal 417-154 With Safeguard Clauses

key_facts.fact: The European Parliament voted 417 to 154, with 71 abstentions, to advance legislation implementing the Turnberry trade agreement with the United States.
key_facts.excerpt: The EU assembly voted by 417 to 154, and 71 abstentions in favour of the legislation, although with added safeguards, reflecting concerns that the Washington may not stick to the deal struck in Turnberry, Scotland, last July.

key_facts.fact: Under the deal, Europe removes tariffs on most US industrial goods and agricultural products, while the US imposes a 15% rate on many European imports but maintains 50% duties on steel and aluminum.
key_facts.excerpt: The legislation would set tariffs at 15% for most EU goods - down from the 30% initially threatened - in exchange for European investment in the US and the removal of EU import duties on US industrial goods.

key_facts.fact: MEPs added a suspension clause that halts the deal if the US introduces tariffs above 15% or threatens EU territorial sovereignty, plus a 'sunrise clause' requiring the US to uphold its commitments first.
key_facts.excerpt: Lawmakers moved to strengthen its safeguards, including a provision to suspend the agreement if the US imposes additional tariffs above 15% or introduces new duties on EU goods. Another would halt the deal if the US threatened the EU's territorial sovereignty.

key_facts.fact: European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic called the vote a 'crucial step' delivering certainty for EU businesses. Final ratification by member states is expected in April or May.
key_facts.excerpt: European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic called the vote a 'crucial step', delivering certainty for EU businesses.

key_facts.fact: The US is the EU's largest trading partner, with EU exports to the US reaching a record €555 billion in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: The US is the EU's largest trading partner, with EU exports to the US rising to a record €555 billion in 2025.

stories.headline: FDA Approves Corcept's Lifyorli, First Glucocorticoid Receptor Antagonist for Ovarian Cancer

key_facts.fact: The FDA approved Lifyorli (relacorilant) on March 25, 2026, the first selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist approved for cancer, in combination with nab-paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
key_facts.excerpt: FDA Approves Corcept's Selective Glucocorticoid Receptor Antagonist Lifyorli (relacorilant) Plus Nab-Paclitaxel for Treatment of Patients with Platinum-Resistant Ovarian Cancer.

key_facts.fact: In the ROSELLA trial of 381 patients, Lifyorli plus nab-paclitaxel showed 16.0 months overall survival vs. 11.9 months — a 35% reduction in death risk (HR: 0.65; p=0.0004).
key_facts.excerpt: Overall Survival: 16.0 months (Lifyorli + nab-paclitaxel) vs. 11.9 months (nab-paclitaxel alone) — 35% reduction in death risk (HR: 0.65; p=0.0004; 4.1-month difference).

key_facts.fact: The drug works by inhibiting cortisol's suppression of apoptosis, enhancing chemotherapy sensitivity — a novel mechanism of action in oncology.
key_facts.excerpt: Selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist (SGRA) that enhances chemotherapy sensitivity by inhibiting cortisol's suppression of apoptosis. First FDA-approved drug in this class.

key_facts.fact: Progression-free survival also improved with a 30% reduction in disease progression risk (HR: 0.70; p=0.008).
key_facts.excerpt: Progression-Free Survival: 30% reduction in disease progression risk (HR: 0.70; p=0.008).

stories.headline: Kodiak Sciences Reports Positive Phase 3 Results for Zenkuda in Diabetic Retinopathy

key_facts.fact: In the GLOW2 Phase 3 trial, 62.5% of patients receiving Zenkuda (tarcocimab tedromer) achieved a ≥2-step improvement in diabetic retinopathy severity vs. 3.3% for sham (p<0.0001), all on a 6-month dosing interval.
key_facts.excerpt: 62.5% of Zenkuda-treated patients achieving a ≥2-step improvement in diabetic retinopathy severity score (DRSS) compared to 3.3% sham (p<0.0001).

key_facts.fact: Zenkuda demonstrated an 85% risk reduction in sight-threatening complications, with only 2.4% of treated patients vs. 15.8% on sham experiencing such events (p=0.0001).
key_facts.excerpt: 85% risk reduction in sight-threatening complications (2.4% Zenkuda vs. 15.8% sham, p=0.0001).

key_facts.fact: Zero intraocular inflammation cases were reported in the trial, confirming a strong safety profile, and the company plans to accelerate its BLA submission timeline.
key_facts.excerpt: Zero intraocular inflammation cases reported. Company intends to accelerate the BLA submission timeline.

key_facts.fact: GLOW2 is the second positive Phase 3 study for Zenkuda, building on GLOW1 results, with the drug also being developed for retinal vein occlusion and wet AMD.
key_facts.excerpt: Building on the success of GLOW1 and with all patients on a 6-month dosing interval, Zenkuda demonstrated superiority to sham.

stories.headline: Viking Therapeutics Completes Phase 3 Enrollment of Obesity Drug VK2735 in 1,000 Patients

key_facts.fact: Viking Therapeutics completed enrollment of approximately 1,000 adults in its Phase 3 VANQUISH-2 trial of subcutaneous VK2735, a dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist for obesity.
key_facts.excerpt: Viking Therapeutics announced the completion of patient enrollment in its Phase 3 VANQUISH-2 clinical trial of subcutaneous VK2735.

key_facts.fact: The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial will assess VK2735 administered by weekly injection for 78 weeks in adults with obesity (BMI ≥30) or overweight (BMI ≥27) with type 2 diabetes.
key_facts.excerpt: The Phase 3 VANQUISH-2 study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial designed to assess the efficacy and safety of VK2735 administered by subcutaneous injection once weekly for 78 weeks.

key_facts.fact: The primary endpoint is percent change in body weight from baseline at 78 weeks, with secondary endpoints including the percentage achieving ≥5%, ≥10%, ≥15%, and ≥20% weight reduction.
key_facts.excerpt: The primary endpoint of the trial is the percent change in body weight from baseline for participants receiving VK2735 as compared to placebo after 78 weeks of treatment.

key_facts.fact: VANQUISH-2 follows the completion of VANQUISH-1 enrollment in November 2025, positioning VK2735 as a challenger to Ozempic and similar GLP-1 drugs in the obesity market.
key_facts.excerpt: Enrollment in the VANQUISH-1 study was completed in November 2025.
